prompt_json.q: What a 2x or 3x fund does
steps: A 2x or 3x fund aims for two or three times the index's move for one day. Then it resets.
Take $100 in a 2x fund. The index drops 10%, so the fund drops 20%, to $80.
Next day the index rises 10%. The fund gains 20%, but only on $80, so it reaches $96.
Over the two days the index lost 1%. The 2x fund lost 4%. Chop works against these funds.
